svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of the VXC Motors simulation: staff agents call the LLM through a logging, firewalled proxy, run tool calls against the dealership's applications, send mail that rings the recipient's doorbell, and reach a BMW tech-support agent through the BMW portal.
svg.title: Animated diagram of the VXC Motors simulation: staff agents call the LLM through a logging, firewalled proxy, run tool calls against the dealership's applications, send mail that rings the recipient's doorbell, and reach a BMW tech-support agent through the BMW portal.
svg.text: · a BMW dealership where every employee is an LLM agent

g.text: Tom (sales) asks the LLM what to do. Every LLM call goes through the proxy, tagged X-Agent-User: tom-becker.
The LLM answers with a tool call: crm_find_customer. Tom's agent runs it against the CRM service.
Email is a tool too: mail_send stores the message in Daniel's mailbox.
The director rings Daniel's doorbell: “you have mail” (never the text itself).
Daniel's agent asks the LLM, then calls mail_read. So every message is in the proxy log twice.
Aisha opens a BMW tech case: a judgment tool answered by another agent, also through the proxy.

svg.text: 74 tools · 8 applications · customers and BMW desks are agents too
one recorded live day ships in demo/data (no API key needed)
